title: World Models Need a Physical Registry: Learning Internal Predictive States for Physically Plausible World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video world models must generate physically plausible futures, not just realistic frames. Existing approaches typically use semantic, physical, or predictive information to guide the visual generation stream, leaving a fundamental question: where inside the generator should predictions of scene evolution live? Standard video tokens jointly encode appearance and dynamics, but provide no distinct state for learning and reading predictive dynamics. We answer this question with the Physical Registry: temporally grounded registry slots inside a video DiT that are initialized from an observation-conditioned forecast, co-evolve with video tokens, and receive future-representation supervision, making predictive dynamics an explicit, readable state of the generator. translated_title: 世界模型需要物理注册表：为物理合理的世界模型学习内部预测状态
translated_abstract: 视频世界模型必须生成物理上合理的未来，而不仅仅是逼真的画面。现有方法通常使用语义、物理或预测信息来引导视觉生成流，这留下了一个根本性问题：场景演化的预测应该存在于生成器内部的什么位置？标准的视频token同时编码外观和动态，但没有提供一个独立的状态来学习和读取预测动态。我们用“物理注册表”回答了这个问题：它是嵌入视频DiT内部的时间定位注册槽，由观测条件化的预测初始化，与视频token共同演化，并接受未来表征的监督，从而使预测动态成为生成器的一个显式且可读取的状态。在Physics-IQ Verified基准上对预测状态接口的受控比较中，物理注册表在I2V/V2V任务上比普通微调提升了9.9/8.7分，是各方法中最大的增益。
tldr: 提出物理注册表，通过在视频DiT内部设置显式、可读取的预测状态槽并辅以未来表征监督，使世界模型生成物理上更合理的未来视频。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Physical Registry—explicit, readable predictive state slots inside a video DiT with future-representation supervision—that enables world models to generate physically plausible future videos.
